verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken structure. 'HOHOHO' sits below its own subtitle instead of before AGENCY, the lower 60% is a scatter of disconnected decorations (the blue ring with zig-zags floating in the middle, cropped circles, stray tick marks), and the red and black shapes are jammed into the bottom-left corner. In A, HOHOHO shrinks to the size of a footnote and loses its equal weight with AGENCY from the original. B keeps HOHOHO large, which is truer to the original, but now it squeezes the italic subtitle between two heavy lines, and the top-right triangle touches the canvas edge.
